name: ads-conversions
description: Sends a server-side conversion to Google Ads, TikTok and LinkedIn for each form submission, with hashed contact details and the ad click ID, to back up the browser tags.

public_url.title: Site address
public_url.description: For example https://example.com. Used for the OAuth redirect addresses and as the page the conversion came from.

notify_email.title: Alert email
notify_email.description: Optional. Told once when a connection needs reconnecting. Empty = no mail.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Form slugs, one per line. Empty means nothing is sent.

email_field.title: Email field
email_field.description: Name of the form field that holds the email address.

phone_field.title: Phone field
phone_field.description: Name of the form field that holds the phone number.

first_name_field.title: First name field
first_name_field.description: Names are never sent or stored. Kept for a later version.

last_name_field.title: Last name field
last_name_field.description: Names are never sent or stored. Kept for a later version.

consent_field.title: Consent field
consent_field.description: Optional. When set, a conversion is sent only if this form field is ticked or answered yes.

default_country_code.title: Default country code
default_country_code.description: Optional, digits only, for example 49. Used for phone numbers without a + or 00 prefix.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Optional three-letter code, for example EUR.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: From a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Web application with the Data Manager API enabled.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: Stored here and never shown again.

google_customer_id.title: Google Ads customer ID
google_customer_id.description: The account that owns the conversion action. Dashes are ignored.

google_login_customer_id.title: Google Ads manager ID
google_login_customer_id.description: Optional. The manager account, if you access the customer through one.

tiktok_access_token.title: TikTok access token
tiktok_access_token.description: The Events API token from Events Manager. Stored here and never shown again.

tiktok_test_event_code.title: TikTok test event code
tiktok_test_event_code.description: Optional. From Events Manager > Test events. Used only by the Test button; live conversions never carry it.

linkedin_client_id.title: LinkedIn client ID
linkedin_client_id.description: From a LinkedIn app with Conversions API access.

linkedin_client_secret.title: LinkedIn client secret
linkedin_client_secret.description: Stored here and never shown again.
